statements.text: This is our leverage as government. We take that leverage with these data center moratoriums and we force (tech companies) to the table, so they can agree to regulations that will protect our resources, protect our safety and our security, and ensure that we are not completely destroying our labor economy as well.

I think it’s also something that has motivated me into making sure that we sign on finally onto the UN’s Declaration of Human Rights and guaranteeing the rights to housing and health care and nutritional food as basic rights in our Constitution. Because if, you know, AI changes work as we know it, and the social contract that we have is that if you work, then that contract is broken and you need to replace it with something else that protects people’s dignity. And so this is going to change everything, and I don’t think we have enough folks that are talking about it in a meaningful way.
statements.venue: Interview with Drop Site News and the American Prospect

statements.text: We’re talking about fascism. We’re talking about climate apocalypse. We’re talking about a complete and dramatic upheaval of the labor economy because of job automation and the advancement of AI.

I do feel like there is an interesting connection that I think is being intentionally and correctly drawn between AI and our climate right now in a way that is going to propel us toward being able to pass some really meaningful climate legislation.
the missing component of AI, and how that all factors into all of our legislation, specifically when it comes to the climate, that we need to be focused on.

Denver voters have made clear that they are very concerned about AI data centers straining our grid and spiking electric bills while a few corporations profit. I support Senator Sanders and Representative Ocasio-Cortez’s data center moratorium — not to stop innovation, but to force these corporations to the table and ensure they are accountable.

That’s the kind of foreign policy that’s actually in line with the values of the American people and would actually lead to true peace building and true cooperation on the global stage, that we are desperately in need of, especially in this moment as we’re facing the crises of things like AI and climate change.
